about: Each case holds one refund of tenant-1/proj-1 for an approval, files the answers its setup names with the authority of each kind it lists, and retries the call at the next minute. Under signed the roster is roster-a, in which alice operates tenant-1/proj-1, bob operates tenant-1/proj-2 and reads tenant-1/proj-1, and carol administers tenant-1/proj-1; an answer is alice's approval of the hold unless the setup says otherwise. Under directory an answer is a claim filed under the hold's approval id. The outcome is what the retry comes to: runs, pending (the hold stays and the agent is told to retry), rejected (the held trail closes APPROVAL_REJECTED), closed (the held trail closes with the plane's own approval, expired, under the code given), indeterminate (the retry is blocked INDETERMINATE and the hold stays), reconciled (a restart closes the hold under the code given), or refused (New refuses the configuration). A case marked control is the negative control of its rule.
